META_TITLE: A Budget App That Needs No Bank Connection — FincWin
META_DESCRIPTION: FincWin is a budget app that installs to your home screen and needs no bank login. Add transactions by hand or by CSV. Your data is stored in your FincWin account. Free to start.
OG_DESCRIPTION: A budget app that needs no bank connection. Installs as a PWA and stores your records in your FincWin account. Free.
PAGE_TITLE: Budget App Without a Bank Connection
HERO_HEADLINE: A budget app that doesn’t need your bank
HERO_SUBHEAD: FincWin installs to your phone or desktop as an app. No bank login, no aggregator, no connection to your bank required.
PROBLEM_HEADLINE: Most budget apps are built around a bank link
PROBLEM_BODY:
They depend on a live connection to your bank, usually through a third-party aggregator that needs your banking credentials. If you don’t want to hand over a bank login, they have little to offer.

FincWin is built the other way. You add transactions by hand or by CSV. Your data lives in your own account, not on your phone alone. FincWin keeps every household’s records isolated from every other household, and lets you export or permanently delete your data at any time.
CAPABILITIES:
• ✓Installs as a PWA on iOS, Android, Windows and Mac.
  • ✓No bank login — add transactions manually or by CSV.
  • ✓Full budgeting — envelopes, goals, loans, analytics.
  • ✓Stored in your FincWin account — export or delete your data any time.

FAQ_ITEMS:
Do I need to connect my bank?

No. You add transactions by hand or import a CSV exported from your bank. FincWin never asks for your bank login.

Where is my data stored?

Your data lives in your own account, not on your phone alone. FincWin keeps every household’s records isolated from every other household, and lets you export or permanently delete your data at any time. You can also save a backup copy to your own Google Drive.

Is it free?

Yes — the free plan is permanent. Pro ($39/year or $149 lifetime) adds CSV import and AI coaching.
